goal: Fix Linux PowerShell 7.7 / Ubuntu 26.04 aarch64 runtime bugs: symlink dereferencing, Add-Type WPF guard, and IsLinux read-only variable collision
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Resolve symlink realpath in scripts/nsclouddrive so /usr/local/bin/nsclouddrive correctly locates src/cli/nsclouddrive.ps1.
2. Guard PresentationCore and System.Web.Extensions Add-Type calls in src/services/CloudTransferManager.ps1 on Linux where missing assemblies cause terminating errors.

3. Rename local $isLinux variables to $onLinux across ConnectionState.ps1, ProviderContract.ps1, SettingsManager.ps1, and VirtualDriveManager.ps1 to eliminate collision with PowerShell Core 7.4+ read-only $IsLinux automatic constant.
4. Verify all automated test suites pass with exit code 0.

decisions.decision: Use readlink -f in scripts/nsclouddrive to resolve symlink target directory before computing REPO_ROOT.
decisions.rationale: Prevents SCRIPT_DIR from resolving to /usr/local/bin when installed globally.

decisions.decision: Wrap Windows-only assembly loads (PresentationCore, System.Web.Extensions) in $onWindows check.
decisions.rationale: Add-Type for non-existent assemblies in pwsh on Linux produces an uncatchable terminating error under $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'.

decisions.decision: Rename local $isLinux variables to $onLinux across all modules.
decisions.rationale: PowerShell variables are case-insensitive and $IsLinux is a built-in read-only automatic variable in PowerShell Core 7.4+.

reviewFindings.notes: Audited strict mode safety, POSIX ACL compatibility, non-blocking UI dispatcher, and granular 1:1 commit compliance. All tests passed with exit code 0.
